name: Firemoon Storyboard Studio
original_description: Create 2–6 ordered storyboard frames from a brief and shot descriptions, optionally using an attached reference. Animate frames and join 2–4 short clips. Character continuity is not guaranteed. Results appear in an inline canvas with Open and Download; videos include playback and fullscreen. Start using the tools without Firemoon account linking. An existing Firemoon account can optionally be connected to use its current entitlements.
description_scope: ChatGPT詳細画面の提供元の英語説明。
summary_ja: 指示や参考画像から2〜6枚の絵コンテを作り、短い動画をつなぐ。
limitations_ja: 人物の一貫性は保証されないと明記。Firemoonのアカウント連携なしで開始でき、既存アカウントを任意で連携できると説明。
review: 詳細画面の説明と情報欄を確認。実動作、料金、品質、権利条件は未検証。
